Amondys 45 (casimersen) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-539206  
Guideline Name 
Amondys 45 (casimersen)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
4/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Amondys 45  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming BOTH of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD)  


--- PDF page 89 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 89 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Disease is confirmed by the presence of a mutation of the dystrophin gene amenable to 
exon 45 skipping  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 7 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist with expertise in the treatment of DMD  
 
AND 
 
4 - Dose will NOT exceed 30 milligrams per kilogram of body weight infused once weekly  
 
AND 
 
5 - Submission of medical records including results of baseline North Star Ambulatory 
Assessment (NSAA) confirming the patient is ambulatory without needing an assistive device 
(e.g., without side-by-side assist, cane, walker, wheelchair) as evidenced by NSAA scoring  
 
AND 
 
6 - Patient will NOT receive Amondys 45 in combination with Duvyzat (givinostat) or other 
exon-skipping therapies for DMD [e.g., Exondys 51 (eteplirsen), Viltepso (viltolarsen), 
Vyondys 53 (golodirsen)]  
 
Product Name:Amondys 45  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


--- PDF page 90 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 90 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is tolerating therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist with expertise in the treatment of DMD  
 
AND 
 
3 - Dose will NOT exceed 30 milligrams per kilogram of body weight infused once weekly  
 
AND 
 
4 - Submission of medical records including results of recent North Star Ambulatory 
Assessment (NSAA) confirming patient is maintaining ambulatory status without needing an 
assistive device (e.g., without side-by-side assist, cane, walker, wheelchair) as evidenced by 
NSAA scoring  
 
AND 
 
5 - Patient will NOT receive Amondys 45 in combination with Duvyzat (givinostat) or other 
exon-skipping therapies for DMD [e.g., Exondys 51 (eteplirsen), Viltepso (viltolarsen), 
Vyondys 53 (golodirsen)]
